name: Ontology-mapped named entities from ChIP-Atlas and RNA-Seq BioSample records, as RDF
description: RDF conversion of BioSample Plus release 2026-06_mistral-small3.1-24b-v2, produced with insdc-rdf: 6,746,471 ontology-mapped annotations from 4,189,039 result entries, using 38,737 distinct terms, as schema:PropertyValue nodes on BioSample IRIs, with the 311 bsllmner-mk2 runs as prov:Activity provenance. 47,307,387 triples in N-Triples, Turtle and JSON-LD.

software.name: insdc-rdf
software.description: Converts INSDC metadata dumps (BioSample, BioProject, SRA) and bsllmner-mk2 releases to RDF.

intro: This release is the RDF form of BioSample Plus release [`2026-06_mistral-small3.1-24b-v2`](https://biosampleplus.s3.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/releases/2026-06_mistral-small3.1-24b-v2/), converted with [insdc-rdf](https://github.com/inutano/insdc-rdf). Each ontology term bsllmner-mk2 assigned to a BioSample field becomes a `schema:PropertyValue` attached to the BioSample with `schema:additionalProperty`, and each bsllmner-mk2 run becomes a `prov:Activity`.
The BioSample IRIs are those of the INSDC RDF release `2026-10_insdc-rdf` in this bucket. Load both into one graph to query annotations together with the original BioSample attributes.
notes: Annotation nodes carry `schema:propertyID` (the field, for example `cell_line`) and no `schema:name`, so queries on the submitters' attributes (`schema:name`) are unaffected by the annotations.
Term IRIs are written exactly as bsllmner-mk2 produced them, without normalization. The terms carry only `rdf:type schema:DefinedTerm` and `rdfs:label`.

The ontology files the terms come from are not part of this release: they are in the source crate under `ontology/`. They are flat term lists (label, synonyms, definition) with no `rdfs:subClassOf`, so loading them alongside adds synonyms and definitions but no term hierarchy.

Cellosaurus (`http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/Cellosaurus#CVCL_…`) and NCBI Gene (`http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCBIGene_…`) term IRIs are bsllmner-mk2's own and do not resolve (HTTP 404). They match the crate's ontology files, not the IRIs that Cellosaurus or NCBI publish.
The annotations reflect the BioSample records bsllmner-mk2 read in May–June 2026, not the 2026-10 NCBI dump, so a few annotated BioSamples may be absent from `2026-10_insdc-rdf`.
Cite the bsllmner-mk2 publication, <https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.02.17.638570>, and this release ID.
terms: Term labels (`rdfs:label`) are taken from third-party ontologies with their own terms: CC BY 4.0 for most, CC BY 3.0 for Uberon, Apache-2.0 for the EFO classes in the Cell Ontology subsets, and public domain for NCBI Gene. Attribute them when redistributing; see <https://biosampleplus.s3.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/SOURCES.md>. The BioSample records the annotations describe come from NCBI, whose terms are listed there too.
